entries.title: Psalms 109:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Do not keep silent, O God of my praise!

entries.title: Psalms 109:2
segments: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful Have opened against me; They have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 109:3
segments: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

entries.title: Psalms 109:4
segments: In return for my love they are my accusers, But I [give myself to] prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 109:5
segments: Thus they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

entries.title: Psalms 109:6
segments: ¶Set a wicked man over him, And let an accuser stand at his right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 109:7
segments: When he is judged, let him be found guilty, And let his prayer become sin.

entries.title: Psalms 109:8
segments: Let his days be few, [And] let another take his office.

entries.title: Psalms 109:9
segments: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

entries.title: Psalms 109:10
segments: Let his children continually be vagabonds, and beg; Let them seek [their bread] also from their desolate places.

entries.title: Psalms 109:11
segments: Let the creditor seize all that he has, And let strangers plunder his labor.

entries.title: Psalms 109:12
segments: Let there be none to extend mercy to him, Nor let there be any to favor his fatherless children.

entries.title: Psalms 109:13
segments: Let his posterity be cut off, [And] in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:14
segments: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:15
segments: Let them be continually before the LORD, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 109:16
segments: Because he did not remember to show mercy, But persecuted the poor and needy man, That he might even slay the broken in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 109:17
segments: As he loved cursing, so let it come to him; As he did not delight in blessing, so let it be far from him.

entries.title: Psalms 109:18
segments: As he clothed himself with cursing as with his garment, So let it enter his body like water, And like oil into his bones.

entries.title: Psalms 109:19
segments: Let it be to him like the garment which covers him, And for a belt with which he girds himself continually.

entries.title: Psalms 109:20
segments: [Let] this [be] the LORD'S reward to my accusers, And to those who speak evil against my person.

entries.title: Psalms 109:21
segments: ¶But You, O GOD the Lord, Deal with me for Your name's sake; Because Your mercy [is] good, deliver me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:22
segments: For I [am] poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:23
segments: I am gone like a shadow when it lengthens; I am shaken off like a locust.

entries.title: Psalms 109:24
segments: My knees are weak through fasting, And my flesh is feeble from lack of fatness.

entries.title: Psalms 109:25
segments: I also have become a reproach to them; [When] they look at me, they shake their heads.

entries.title: Psalms 109:26
segments: Help me, O LORD my God! Oh, save me according to Your mercy,

entries.title: Psalms 109:27
segments: That they may know that this [is] Your hand-[That] You, LORD, have done it!

entries.title: Psalms 109:28
segments: Let them curse, but You bless; When they arise, let them be ashamed, But let Your servant rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 109:29
segments: Let my accusers be clothed with shame, And let them cover themselves with their own disgrace as with a mantle.

entries.title: Psalms 109:30
segments: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; Yes, I will praise Him among the multitude.

entries.title: Psalms 109:31
segments: For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, To save [him] from those who condemn him.
